headline: Your Vinta Software waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing digital health and specialty-care buyers into the right Vinta EHR modernization, dedicated healthtech build, product discovery, or soft remaining-TAM offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for Beatriz Betta (Tech Partnerships).
productSummary: Vinta Software (vintasoftware.com; Miami FL + Recife PE) is a healthcare software development and custom product-engineering agency — not a product SaaS. They craft interoperable, HIPAA-aware digital products for healthcare and beyond, with deep expertise in EHR customization and migration for specialty care workflows, plus end-to-end builds on Django, FastAPI, and React Native. Named services on vintasoftware.com/services: EHR Development & Modernization, Medplum Development, Healthcare Integration & Interoperability, CMS Interoperability Enablement; plus Product Discovery, Web Development, AI Agents & LLM Development, Tech Debt & Legacy, Dedicated Team, Python/Django, Modern JavaScript, and Mobile. Public proof: 4.9 on Clutch (services page); decade-plus delivery (homepage); case work includes Quilted Health (14-year legacy EHR → Medplum, first practice-focused EHR PoC in one month), Rewind (Healthie → Medplum migration after Product Discovery), and a Medplum Transfer Center MVP (HL7 ADT + FHIR real-time patient-flow dashboard). Beatriz Betta leads Tech Partnerships.
coreInsight: Beatriz sells one Vinta healthcare engineering partner (EHR modernization + Medplum/FHIR interop + senior Django/FastAPI/React Native delivery), not a different agency per specialty. Specialty (midwifery, behavioral health, fertility, hospital ops, etc.) is a merge tag after routing, not a second waterfall. The single routing signal is health_eng_hiring_state from LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape: open EHR/FHIR/interop/Health IT eng roles, open software IC roles without those titles, product/digital-health/clinical leadership hiring only, or none of those. That ladder maps to Vinta's live offers — EHR & Interop Partner Brief, Dedicated Healthtech Build Brief, Product Discovery & Interop Assessment, then a soft remaining-TAM Healthtech Build Playbook.

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is how the company is already staffing health-IT and engineering
sections.takeaway: LinkedIn Jobs + careers already show open EHR/FHIR/interop roles, software IC roles, product/digital-health leadership hiring, or none of those. That health_eng_hiring_state is stronger than a title guess and cheap to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every in-TAM digital health and specialty-care buyer
sections.takeaway: First match wins. EHR/interop hiring first, then software IC hiring without Health IT titles, then product/digital-health leadership hiring, then every remaining in-TAM company Vinta sells into.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each hiring state gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: EHR/interop hiring gets an EHR & Interop Partner Brief. Software IC hiring gets a Dedicated Healthtech Build Brief. Leadership-only hiring gets a Product Discovery & Interop Assessment. The rest get the Healthtech Build Playbook.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Modernize the EHR, fill healthtech eng capacity, open discovery, then cover the rest
sections.takeaway: The list is always digital health / specialty-care product buyers Vinta already serves. Specialty (maternal care, behavioral health, hospital ops, etc.) is a merge tag. A/Bs sit on exclusive routes (Medplum/FHIR speed vs dedicated senior Django capacity).

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the hiring state already visible on LinkedIn
sections.takeaway: Notice the open Health IT, eng, or leadership role, poke the EHR-customization / capacity / discovery pain that state implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the EHR / interop hiring route first
sections.takeaway: Start where they already post FHIR/EHR/interop roles and still feel vendor lock or legacy drag. Prove reply density, then roll dedicated build, product discovery, and the remaining-TAM catch-all.

signalReasons: Apollo / LinkedIn Sales Nav filters on digital health, specialty-care software, and healthtech product companies (plus adjacent healthcare platforms that need custom EHR/interop work) are the commercial TAM Beatriz sells into. Public global TAM account count is not published on vintasoftware.com; treat size as estimated (see vinta-magnet-flags.txt) and keep each launch tier ≥~1,500 contacts where possible.

The same Jobs + careers pull returns health_eng_hiring_state: EHR / FHIR / interoperability / Health IT / HL7 / Medplum-adjacent eng roles; software IC roles (Python, Django, FastAPI, React, React Native, mobile, platform, DevOps) without Health IT titles; product / digital health / clinical ops / CTO leadership roles — enough to route without a second expensive enrichment product.

The ladder maps to live Vinta positioning on vintasoftware.com (EHR Development & Modernization, Medplum Development, Healthcare Integration & Interoperability, CMS Interoperability Enablement, Product Discovery, Dedicated Team) plus published proof (4.9 Clutch; Quilted Health one-month Medplum PoC / 14-year legacy EHR; Rewind Healthie→Medplum; Transfer Center HL7 ADT + FHIR).
Buyer title (CTO / VP Eng / Head of Product / Founder) and specialty are scrape filters and merge tags, not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last after the account is routed.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND health_it_role_open = true (EHR Engineer, FHIR Integration, HL7/Interoperability, Health IT, Clinical Systems, Medplum-adjacent) AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They are already staffing Health IT / EHR / FHIR work. Strongest intent for Vinta's EHR modernization, Medplum, and interoperability offers using published proof (4.9 Clutch; Quilted Health one-month PoC; Rewind migration; Transfer Center HL7 ADT + FHIR).

routingRules.if: in_tam AND eng_ic_role_open = true (Python, Django, FastAPI, Full-Stack, Backend, Frontend, React, React Native, Mobile, Platform, DevOps) AND health_it_role_open = false AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They need senior engineering capacity on Vinta's stack without posting Health IT titles yet. Maps to Dedicated Team + end-to-end Django/FastAPI/React Native delivery for specialty workflows.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND leadership_role_open = true (CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Product/Digital Health, Clinical Ops / Innovation lead) AND no Tier 1-2 match AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: Leadership is hiring to own the roadmap. Maps to Vinta Product Discovery + CMS Interoperability Enablement — clarity on build vs migrate vs integrate before a large eng commit.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND none of the above
routingRules.why: Still in TAM (digital health / specialty-care software buyers). Softest CTA around practical EHR modernization, Medplum/FHIR paths, and senior delivery. Mandatory 100% coverage.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: Open EHR / FHIR / interop / Health IT eng roles
tiers.trigger: LinkedIn Jobs or careers page lists EHR Engineer, FHIR Integration, HL7/Interoperability, Health IT, Clinical Systems, or Medplum-adjacent roles; not already a Vinta customer
tiers.pain: They are already trying to hire Health IT talent and still feel EHR vendor lock, thin interoperability, and specialty-workflow gaps while legacy systems resist customization.
tiers.valueProp: EHR & Interop Partner Brief: Vinta as the Medplum/FHIR modernization partner that blueprints before code and anchors to published outcomes (Quilted Health one-month PoC / 14-year legacy rebuild; Rewind Healthie→Medplum; Transfer Center HL7 ADT + FHIR).
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape for EHR/FHIR/interop/Health IT role titles
tiers.replyDensity: Highest - they already budget Health IT delivery
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; not published on vintasoftware.com — keep each tier ≥~1,500 contacts before launch when the TAM allows

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: Open software IC roles, no Health IT titles
tiers.trigger: In-TAM company posts Python, Django, FastAPI, Full-Stack, Backend, Frontend, React, React Native, Mobile, Platform, or DevOps IC roles with no Tier-1 Health IT roles open
tiers.pain: Open eng seats at a healthtech product company usually mean specialty-workflow and platform work is slipping while the team stays understaffed on the exact stack Vinta masters.
tiers.valueProp: Dedicated Healthtech Build Brief: Vinta Dedicated Team + end-to-end Django/FastAPI/React Native delivery as a senior partner, not a body shop — HIPAA-aware builds for specialty care.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers scrape for software IC titles without Health IT roles
tiers.replyDensity: High - visible capacity pain, EHR angle secondary

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Product / digital health / clinical leadership hiring only
tiers.trigger: In-TAM company posts CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Product/Digital Health, or Clinical Ops / Innovation roles with no Tier 1-2 IC matches
tiers.pain: New digital or clinical leadership usually inherits ambiguity — customize the EHR, migrate, or bolt on interop — before any build decision is safe.
tiers.valueProp: Product Discovery & Interop Assessment: Vinta Product Discovery + CMS Interoperability Enablement path — structured evaluation of Medplum/FHIR options, risk/cost framing, no large eng commit required.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Jobs + careers for product/digital-health/clinical leadership titles
tiers.replyDensity: Medium - clear roadmap pain, longer sales cycle

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Remaining in-TAM digital health / specialty-care buyers
tiers.trigger: In-TAM digital health or specialty-care software company with a CTO / VP Eng / Head of Product / Founder buyer and no Tier 1-3 health_eng_hiring_state
tiers.pain: Most specialty-care and digital health teams know their EHR or clinical workflows are holding them back but are unsure whether to customize, migrate, or integrate — so vendor pitches stall and internal backlog grows.
tiers.valueProp: Soft Healthtech Build Playbook: practical EHR modernization and Medplum/FHIR framing, senior Django/FastAPI/React Native delivery, and Vinta's discovery → build path. Soft CTA.
tiers.dataSource: Apollo / Sales Nav after in_tam gate
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; catch-all must cover remaining TAM
